transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our maintenance coordination meeting started. We have four work orders to schedule across four available work windows, and I need your input before I publish the final maintenance plan. The work orders are: Generator G-2 service, Communications Shelter C-1 inspection, Forklift F-4 steering repair, and HVAC Unit H-3 service. The available windows are Friday 1000-1200, Friday 1300-1500, Saturday 0800-1000, and Saturday 1000-1200. Does anyone have any constraints, required parts, safety considerations, or personnel issues I should know about for any of these work orders?
